recommendation: Keep the fixed commit as-is. It completes the FHIR-15605 application without changing the value set canonical or reopening the duplicate FHIR-14145; FHIR-13533 can be audited separately if desired, but its requested value set code is already image in this source.
issue_request: FHIR-15605 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request to reopen duplicate FHIR-14145 and keep the element named Media.type while changing it to a 0..1 CodeableConcept with an extensible Media Type binding, changing the old photo category to image, and using filtering wording for retrieved/displayed media.
initial_application: GF#14145 was first applied by commit 17a86882a2, which changed Media.type to category and added image. GF#15605 was then partially applied by commit e6e73a2910, which restored Media.type and wired the MediaType binding and type search parameter, but current source still had a Media introduction saying the element became category and stale primitive photo/audio constraints.
additional_context: FHIR-14145 is a Duplicate explicitly deferred to FHIR-15605. FHIR-13533 is the same change family for changing the media type code from photo to image; the current code list already uses image. The Zulip #implementers Media.code thread supports the final Jira decision to keep a simple audio/video/image type as an extensible CodeableConcept rather than a repeatable category. source/fhir.ini lists Media as an active OO resource, so the edited Media spreadsheet and introduction are in build scope.
reconciliation: Changed source/media/media-introduction.xml to say the required type became optional Media.type rather than category. Changed source/media/media-spreadsheet.xml so Media.type filters media rather than observations, image-related text no longer uses photo as the type category, and height/width/frames/duration constraints check Media.type.coding against the media-type CodeSystem instead of comparing the CodeableConcept element to primitive photo/audio strings.
source_changes: source/media/media-introduction.xml: corrected the STU note from optional category to optional Media.type and updated the affected element links.
source/media/media-spreadsheet.xml: changed Media.type requirements from filtering observations to filtering media.
source/media/media-spreadsheet.xml: changed image/frames wording from photo-oriented category text to image-oriented text.

source/media/media-spreadsheet.xml: updated height, width, frames, and duration invariants to test CodeableConcept codings from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/media-type for image, video, and audio.
